## Budget

A year's operating budget. Fields: `year`, `name`, `seasonality` (twelve weights used by seasonal lines) and `lines`, a `containsMany(BudgetLine)` of `account`, `annualMinor` and `spread` (`seasonal` or `even`). `accounts` is a `linksToMany(LedgerAccount)` query over the chart, used to name accounts and sort them into income, cost of goods sold and expenses.

### Computed
- `spreads` (`BudgetSpread`: `account`, `annualMinor`, twelve `amounts`) spreads each line with the `@cardstack/bxl` formula `ROUND(annual × weight ÷ SUM(weights), 0)` per month; December takes the rounding so the months always add to the annual amount. Even lines, or a budget without twelve weights, use equal weights.
- `netIncomeMinor`: income lines less every other line.

The isolated view lays the spread out as a month-by-month statement with section totals and net income. Budget against Actual reads `spreads`.

The card has no operations.

```ts
import { Budget } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-analysis';
```

### Non-goals
No balance-sheet budgeting, no versions or approval workflow, and no budgeting by class or location.

### Example
`Budget/2026`, a 2026 operating budget spread evenly.
